title: Screw post, M2 / M2.5 / M3
summary: A round post off the floor for a board with mounting holes. Either the nut drops into a hex trap in the floor's underside and the screw goes in from the top, or the screw cuts its own thread in a pilot hole. Sizes M2, M2.5 and M3; the library says which screw length reaches.

views.label: Nut trap and tap post
views.caption: M2.5 on a 2.4 floor. Left: clearance hole with the nut trapped underneath. Right: blind pilot hole the screw threads itself into. Cut it open to see the trap.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: A row per size, M2 at the front. Dots 1–3: nut traps at three clearances. Dot 4: tap post.

specs.title: Sizes
specs.note: Floor at least nut height + 0.4 for a trap: 2.0 for M2, 2.4 for M2.5, 2.9 for M3.

checks: Nut traps: does the nut push in and stay, sitting flush?
Does the screw pull the nut up without it spinning?
Tap post: does the screw cut a thread without splitting the post?
Does it hold after taking it out and putting it back twice?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, in the enclosure's material.
